package.name: kontrolem_locomotion
package.description: Kontrol'Em v2 concrete gait patterns: morphology-specific GaitSource implementations (quadruped CrawlGait / TrotGait now; humanoid/biped gaits later) that emit the GaitPlan a whole-body or kinematic controller executes to walk. Header-only, ROS-independent. The locomotion analogue of kontrolem_controllers (impl) against the kontrolem_control (contract) GaitSource seam — so robot-specific gait patterns never accrete in the core.
